text: Access control and authorization should normally bind to the immediate caller and explicit roles. Transaction-origin checks can be confused by intermediary contracts.
External calls can transfer control. Update critical state before interaction where possible and use a reentrancy guard when the invariant spans external execution.
Oracle consumers should validate freshness, expected update cadence, fallback behavior, and the economic effect of manipulation or delay.
Upgradeable systems must constrain implementation selection, protect upgrade authority, preserve storage layout, and make upgrade events observable.
Bridge security depends on message-domain separation, replay protection, verifier correctness, and a quorum that remains safe under validator compromise.
